scorecard.title: College Scorecard (location, enrollment, cost; data released 2026-10-15)

cds.title: Butler University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (sections A-J, PDF, Institutional Research)

stats.notes: From the Common Data Set (Fall 2025 entering class): 11,139 applied, 9,144 admitted (82.1%), 1,292 enrolled; residency rows (in-state / out-of-state / international) add up to the totals. International (nonresident) first-years: 403 applied, 187 admitted, 39 enrolled. The Early Decision figure (20 applied, 17 admitted) covers Butler's Nursing-only Early Decision plan; Early Action counts are not reported. The CDS says Butler has a waiting list but leaves the waitlist counts blank. The GPA breakdown is the 'all enrolled students' column (C11) and 0.00% had a GPA below 1.0; the average GPA of 3.84 (C12) covers 99.92% of the class. SAT/ACT percentiles cover enrolled first-years who submitted scores (SAT 38%, ACT 14%); Butler is test-optional although the CDS C7 grid rates test scores 'very important'. Undergraduate enrollment (4,418) and the nonresident count (80) are the 'Total Undergraduates' figures from B1 and B2.

cost.notes: First-year, full-time costs for 2026-27 from the Common Data Set (G1, G5): tuition $50,860, required fees $990, food and housing $17,730 (housing $8,890 + food $8,840, double room and the full meal plan). Estimated expenses: books $1,100, transportation $1,400, other $3,000 (other costs shown = transportation + other). Per-credit-hour tuition $2,110. The total of $75,080 is the 2026-27 cost of attendance printed on Butler's Tuition & Costs page ($69,580 direct + $5,500 indirect); the CDS prints no total. CDS H6: for degree-seeking nonresidents only institutional non-need-based (merit) aid is available; the CDS leaves the number of nonresidents awarded aid and the average award blank.
